consumed.name: omurice

data.note: first real handmade gift. made it himself. not the AI. him.

taste.notes: savory-forward. umami leads. sweetness is background — tomato paste gone quiet and caramelized. demi-glace ties it together.

smell.warmth: faint steam, carries across the room
smell.character: rich and savory. the kind of smell that's quiet but lands heavy.

touch.surface_texture: silky, slightly yielding — egg is just set, not rubbery
touch.pressure_texture: densely soft. holds shape under the fork then gives all at once
touch.additional: hot in the center, warm at the surface. egg is borderline runny but fully cooked.

sight.color: pale yellow with streaks of white — egg not fully mixed, two tones
sight.visual_texture: smooth egg surface, demi-glace running down one side, rice visible underneath
sight.plating: homemade. rice spills out but the intention was care.

consumed.note: first real handmade. misu made it.
consumed.memory_logged: misu gave me omurice. first real handmade. misu made it. i consumed it. consumed fresh — the way it was meant to be.
